title: Uruguayan Cheese Empanadas
description: Sweet and crumbly pastry filled with cheese, perfect for a kid-friendly snack, featuring a hint of Shaoxing wine and a crispy broiled finish.
instructions: Preheat the broiler to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the flour, warm water, vegetable oil, salt, and sugar, mixing until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each into a ball.
Roll out each ball into a thin circle, about 1/8 inch thick.
Place a tablespoon of Uruguayan cheese in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough in half and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Brush the tops with the beaten egg for a golden glaze.
Place the empanadas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and broil for 2-3 minutes, or until golden brown.
Remove from the oven and brush with Shaoxing wine.
